content.user_title: Configure Markstream for Vue 2 and Vite
content.value_statement: Vue 2 and Vite projects can need different worker imports, CSS order, and streaming settings. This skill provides focused integration guidance for markstream-vue2 with safe defaults.
actual_capabilities: Checks whether the repository uses Vue 2 and Vite before applying guidance.
Explains Vite-compatible worker imports with ?worker and ?worker&inline.
Recommends importing Markstream CSS after reset styles.
Configures MarkdownRender settings for streaming content and completed history.
Explains safe HTML policy and Mermaid strict mode defaults.
Suggests using the smallest useful Vite development or build validation command.
limitations: It is limited to Vue 2 projects that use Vite.
It does not install packages or modify project files without host-agent approval.
It does not replace package documentation for unsupported integrations.
Trusted HTML and relaxed Mermaid settings require a separate security review.

use_cases.title: Add bundled workers
use_cases.description: Set up Mermaid or KaTeX workers with Vite-compatible imports instead of CDN workers.

use_cases.title: Build a streaming chat view
use_cases.description: Configure MarkdownRender for smooth streamed responses and completed conversation history.

use_cases.title: Migrate a legacy Vue app
use_cases.description: Preserve Vue 2 compatibility while introducing Markstream CSS and safe rendering defaults.

prompt_templates.title: Check project fit
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether this repository uses Vue 2 and Vite, then list the markstream-vue2 integration steps that apply.

prompt_templates.title: Add Markstream styles
prompt_templates.prompt: Show where to import markstream-vue2/index.css in this Vue 2 Vite project. Keep reset styles before Markstream styles.

prompt_templates.title: Configure a bundled worker
prompt_templates.prompt: Configure a Vite worker import for the requested markstream-vue2 Mermaid feature. Use a bundled worker pattern and explain the chosen import.

prompt_templates.title: Tune streaming and history
prompt_templates.prompt: Configure MarkdownRender for a Vue 2 chat interface. Use smooth streaming while content arrives, then switch to completed history when final is true. Keep safe HTML and Mermaid strict mode.

output_examples.input: Set up Markstream styling in my Vue 2 Vite application.
output: Confirm the project uses Vue 2 and Vite.
Import Markstream CSS after UnoCSS, Tailwind, or other reset styles.
Validate the change with the smallest useful Vite command.

output_examples.input: My chat messages stream gradually and later load from history.
output: Use automatic smooth streaming while a message is active.
Disable streaming pacing after the message is final.
Keep fade behavior appropriate for completed history entries.

best_practices: Confirm Vue 2 and Vite before using this bundler-specific guidance.
Prefer bundled workers over CDN workers for Vite deployments.
Keep safe HTML policy and Mermaid strict mode unless a reviewed trusted surface requires otherwise.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for Vue 3 or non-Vite projects.
Do not place Markstream CSS before reset styles.
Do not enable trusted HTML or relaxed Mermaid settings for untrusted content.

faq.question: Which projects is this skill for?
faq.answer: It is for applications that use Vue 2 with Vite-based tooling.

faq.question: Does it support CDN workers?
faq.answer: It recommends bundled Vite workers rather than CDN workers.

faq.question: Where should Markstream CSS be imported?
faq.answer: Import it after reset styles such as UnoCSS or Tailwind resets.

faq.question: How should streaming messages be configured?
faq.answer: Use automatic smooth streaming during active responses and disable pacing after final content is complete.

faq.question: Is trusted HTML enabled by default?
faq.answer: No. The guidance keeps the safe HTML policy as the default.

faq.question: Does the skill change files automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides integration guidance for the host agent to apply with appropriate approval.
